call_points.text: Cost of funds seen broadly stable for the rest of FY27, with no further reduction expected
Raised ₹3,868 Cr from banks and ₹1,271 Cr from NCDs and commercial paper in the quarter
Capital adequacy 24.7% at the NBFC and 27.8% at the housing arm; leverage 3.7x
Management says no CEO position is vacant and none is planned
ROA target for FY27 is about 4% and ROE not less than 16%.

operating_notes.text: Gold loan AUM reached ₹16,965 crores, up 33% QoQ.
Gold Loan branch network reached 1,000 across India.
Moody's issuer rating on Capri Global is Ba3 stable; the USD 1 billion GMTN programme is rated provisional (P)Ba3.
Standalone GNPA was 1.02% and NNPA 0.56% at June 30, 2026, with CAR at 24.66%.
ICRA assigned [ICRA]A1+ to the ₹1,500 Cr Commercial Paper Programme on 2026-07-28.
Q1FY27 cost of borrowings fell to 9.1% from 9.7% a year ago, lifting spread to 7.8% and NIM to 9.7%.
Q1FY27 co-lending AUM was ₹14,026 Cr, 20.3% of consolidated AUM, with co-lending income at ₹65 Cr.
Q1FY27 gold loan AUM was ₹19,179 Cr with 1,018,080 live accounts and 20.2 tonnes collateral in custody.
AI collaboration with OpenAI to enhance customer service and operational processes across 1,400+ branches
Q1FY27 gold loan AUM ₹19,179 Cr, up 111% YoY and 13% QoQ, with collateral of 20.2 tonnes and gross NPA of 0.3%.
Q1FY27 car loan distribution origination ₹3,282 Cr, up 43% YoY, across 13 partner banks and financial institutions.
Average gold loan-to-value at disbursement is about 71%; auction notices are issued when LTV breaches 85%.
Q1FY27 AUM growth was driven by MSME, Gold, and Housing segments.
Fitch assigned an expected 'BB-(EXP)' rating to Capri Global's proposed USD senior secured notes under a U.S.$ 1 bn GMTN Programme; issuer shown as BB-/Stable.
US$ 300 mn 7.55% notes due 2029 were 2.3x oversubscribed with a US$ 700 mn+ book across 64 accounts; asset managers took 91% and the US 49% by region.
AUM was over ₹40,000 Cr with 7.6 lakh+ customers, 1,400+ branches and 13,700+ employees as of June 30, 2026.
Moody's assigned Ba3 to Capri Global's senior secured USD notes and (P)Ba3 to its US$1.0 bn GMTN Programme, a second agency view after Fitch's BB-(EXP).
Capri Gold Loans runs through 1,100+ branches across 16 states and UTs and has served over 14.5 lakh customers to date.
The four-day Vyapar Mahotsav offer prices gold loans from 11% p.a. with zero processing fees, aimed at traders and small businesses ahead of the festive season.
Capri Global approved issuance of up to USD 30 million senior secured dollar bonds at SOFR + 240 bps maturing in 36 months.

timeline.summary: Capri Global Capital Limited scheduled an earnings conference call for Q4 FY26 and year ended March 31, 2026, on May 4, 2026, at 4:00 PM IST via dial-in.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,384.98 Cr (+44.7% YoY), net profit ₹282.81 Cr (+59.1% YoY).
April 30, 2026: Board approved increase in aggregate borrowing limits from ₹25,000 Cr to ₹35,000 Cr, subject to shareholder approval at the AGM
Capri Global Capital announced the successful oversubscription and closure of its Tranche I public NCD issue aggregating up to ₹500 Cr.
Capri Global reported Q4 FY26 consolidated PAT of ₹283 Cr, up 59% YoY, and full-year FY26 PAT of ₹949 Cr.
May 14, 2026: Capri Global Capital announced its Gold Loan business has crossed 1,000 branches across India with an AUM of over ₹16,960 Cr.
May 19, 2026: Capri Global Capital established its USD 1 billion Global Medium Term Note Programme after receiving a no-comment letter from India INX.
2026-05-20: Fitch Ratings assigned BB-/Stable rating to Capri Global's $1 Billion Global Medium-Term Note programme.
2026-05-20: Moody's Ratings assigned a provisional (P)Ba3 to Capri Global's USD 1 billion GMTN programme, a notch below Fitch's BB-/Stable on the same programme.
Capri Global Capital reported Q1FY27 results with revenue of ₹1,233 Cr and PAT of ₹314 Cr.
On 2026-07-28, ICRA assigned an [ICRA]A1+ rating to Capri Global Capital's ₹1,500 Cr Commercial Paper Programme.
Capri Global filed a revised Q1FY27 investor presentation showing AUM up 62% YoY to ₹40,112 Cr, PAT doubled to ₹353 Cr, and targets of ₹65,000 Cr AUM by FY28 and 19-21% RoAE.
2026-07-29: Capri Loans announces collaboration with OpenAI to implement enterprise-grade AI in lending operations
2026-08-04: Capri Global filed the Q1FY27 earnings call transcript, where management guided FY27 AUM at ₹50,000 Cr and revised the FY28 target to ₹65,000 Cr with 19-21% RoAE.
Capri Global Capital Limited filed its Corporate Presentation for August 2026, detailing Q1FY27 financial performance and strategic initiatives.
Infomerics upgraded Capri Global's bank loan and NCD ratings to IVR AA+/Stable from IVR AA/Positive on August 7, 2026.
2026-08-29: Capri Global files FY26 annual report; AGM scheduled for Sep 22

On September 1, 2026, Fitch Ratings assigned an expected rating of 'BB-(EXP)' to the proposed US dollar-denominated senior secured bonds of Capri Global Capital Limited under its $1 bn GMTN Programme.
2026-09-01: Capri Global files preliminary offering circular for USD 1 bn GMTN Programme on India INX and NSE IFSC
On September 1, 2026, Capri Global approved pricing of USD 300 mn 7.55% senior secured notes due 2029 under its GMTN Programme.
2026-09-02: Capri Global completed its maiden US$ 300 mn senior secured dollar bond at 7.55% due 2029, oversubscribed 2.3x.
2026-09-02: Moody's assigned a Ba3 long-term foreign currency senior secured rating to Capri Global's USD notes, with the US$1.0 bn GMTN programme rated (P)Ba3.
2026-09-09: Capri Global uploaded final supplemental offering circular and pricing supplement for its $300 mn 7.55% senior secured notes due 2029 on India INX and NSE IFSC websites.
2026-09-16: Capri Gold Loans launched 'Vyapar Mahotsav', a four-day pan-India gold loan offer from September 16-19, 2026, with rates from 11% p.a. and zero processing fees.
2026-09-18: Infomerics assigned IVR AA+/Stable rating to proposed ₹300 Cr subordinated NCDs of Capri Global Capital

On 2026-09-22, Acuité Ratings & Research Limited reaffirmed ACUITE AA+|Stable rating on ₹10,550 Cr bank loans and ₹1,296 Cr NCDs, and assigned same rating to ₹2,400 Cr new bank loans and ACUITE A1+ to ₹200 Cr short-term facilities.
Capri Global Capital Ltd’s 32nd AGM, chaired by **L. V. Prabhakar**, held on September 22, 2026, via video conferencing with all directors present.
Capri Global Capital launched its 'Navratri Special Offer' on October 13, 2026, providing a 50% waiver on gold loan processing fees from October 12 to 15, 2026.
Capri Global Capital allotted ₹160 Cr of subordinated NCDs at 9.75% coupon on private placement basis to identified investors on October 13, 2026.
On 2026-10-13, Capri Global Capital received an upgraded ESG rating to Crisil ESG 72 Leadership
Capri Global Capital's Board approved raising of funds up to ₹4,000 Cr via equity, debt or convertible securities, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.
Capri Global Capital issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval to raise up to ₹4,000 Cr via securities issuance.
Capri Global approved issuance of up to USD 30 million in senior secured dollar bonds.
Capri Global Capital reported standalone revenue of ₹1,398.03 Cr and PAT of ₹353.31 Cr for Q2FY27.
